tools.name: search_skills
tools.title: Search skills
tools.description: Search or browse published real estate AI skills in the RealToolbox.ai library. Returns skill metadata (name, slug, tagline, tier, access_level, price). Use get_skill to retrieve full content for a specific skill.

query.description: Optional search text matched against skill name, tagline, and description.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.title: Get skill
tools.description: Fetch a full skill by slug. Metadata is public. The `overview` (full markdown skill content) is included for free skills, or for paid skills only when the signed-in user has an active All-Access subscription. Otherwise a `locked` flag is returned.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.title: List integrations
tools.description: List published integrations in the RealToolbox.ai directory (MCP servers and other tools that connect AI assistants to real estate workflows). Optionally filter by category.

category.description: Optional category slug: property-data, crm, communication, productivity, content-creation, automation, developer.

tools.name: get_my_subscription
tools.title: Get my subscription
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's RealToolbox.ai subscription status (plan, status, current period end). Requires an authenticated caller.
